Wall Collapse in Petlawad Traps Mother-Daughter Under Debris

A house wall collapsed in Petlawad, trapping a mother and daughter under debris. They were rescued after the debris was partially supported by a sofa, preventing further collapse. The incident occurred with an accompanying blast. Eyewitnesses described the terrifying scene, with some recounting how stairs were buried and people escaped through windows.
